description: The user's own accounts on websites (personas): how Writ signs in as them. No password passes through this tool or the conversation, and its answers never ask for one: credentials are typed only into a Writ window. action='list' domain=<site> shows the personas usable there; with none it answers persona_needed: a tell_user for the user, a create_url (a small Writ window with only the sign-in form, pre-filled for the site) and a link_id. action='wait' link_id=<id> is one held call that answers when the user saves it, with its persona_id. Also get, request (a link for another account), sign_in (refresh the session) and record_login. A persona_id works on writ_scrape, writ_crawl_site, writ_browser_use and writ_run_workflow; a desktop persona ('device:...') signs in on that desktop, from its own vault.

action.description: list (default) | get | request | wait | sign_in | record_login.

domain.description: list: personas usable on this site. request: the site.

link_id.description: wait: the link_id of a persona_needed / request answer.

why.description: request: one line the user sees in the window.

name: writ_personas
title: Use the user's saved sign-ins
